models.inputOwnership: 2,168 image/label pairs: 530 owner-shot photos (owner decision 2026-10-29 for #158) and 1,638 PD12M images whose license is CC0 1.0 (1,438) or Public Domain Mark 1.0 (200), fetched with the dataset's md5 and kept with url/license/sha256 in a private ledger. No real-user photos. The scored scenes of #128 and #141 and every owner photo taken on their capture days are excluded.
models.method: Small U-Net trained from scratch by NIHO (no pretrained weights, no third-party model or weights). Labels: SAM2 (Apache-2.0) segment candidates chosen by colour rules and NIHO's own model, reviewed one by one by AI overlay (owner decision 2026-10-29), sky-coloured gaps added by label_fill.py and reviewed. BatchNorm folded into the convolutions by train_sky.py export.
models.reproducibility: Trained at commit 02cb0b8bf577d0cbfdc7b35670aff534dd3f9a7f (kept by refs/pull/183/head; squash-merged as 9078e29 in #183) with train_sky.py train --epochs 40 --long 384 --wire-aug 0.5 --branch-aug 0.3 --window-aug 0.2 --channels 24 48 72 96 --seed 0 (best epoch 34), then export. The private photos, labels and ledger are not a dependency of public build/test. Frozen before one run on #141's 20 evaluation scenes (overall IoU 0.802, sunset 0.845, no-sky false sky 0/3).
